component.name: flatpark-spawn
component.summary: Lets an app run the host's command-line tools

description.p: Shared by the apps that declare it. An app that holds the org.freedesktop.Flatpak permission runs the commands its tools call (git, node, gh, the user's own scripts) on the host, in the user's login-shell PATH, as if they were installed in the sandbox. This runs outside the sandbox on purpose; an app without that permission is not affected.
